offers_products.reason: Sells connectivity as a service; dark fiber and equipment are part of network services, not a main product line.

offers_services.reason: Provides internet, wavelengths, ethernet, backhaul, managed cloud and security services.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Kinetic sells multi-gigabit fiber internet to homes and households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to carriers, hyperscalers, enterprises, banks, hospitals, schools and governments.

recurring_revenue.reason: Monthly internet subscriptions and multi-year wholesale fiber and wavelength contracts generate recurring revenue.

cyclical_demand.reason: Internet and connectivity are essential services that customers rarely cut in a downturn.

big_ticket.reason: Monthly internet, wavelength and managed service billing; small frequent payments rather than large infrequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes from its fiber network and infrastructure, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Kinetic serves many households and small businesses, though wholesale goes to carriers and hyperscalers; mix leans consumer and SMB.

asset_heavy.reason: Builds and operates a nationwide fiber network and Kinetic residential fiber, needing heavy ongoing capital for network construction.

notes: Post-Windstream merger, Kinetic consumer internet is likely the larger part of revenue; wholesale and enterprise are significant.
